decisions.statement: The keyboard chat and the gamepad chat are hooked the same way.
The command a token belongs to is found by walking down the subcommand aliases.
The text before the token is kept so a chosen completion is put back after that text.
The game's own completion runs where no command claims the token.
Matches are ordered from the closest to the token down to the furthest.
Setting up the chat entry runs one time.

definition: the game's chat entry hooked so a command's own completions are offered
